newsitem.title: USA: Coastal completes financing of Pakistan deal.
newsitem.headline: Coastal completes financing of Pakistan deal.

text.p: Coastal Corp said in a statement on Tuesday that its Coastal Power subsidiary had completed the acquisition and related construction financing for a 125 megawatt oil-fired power station in the city of Sheikhupura in Pakistan's Punjab province.
Total project costs for the build-own-operate plant are expected to be $154 million and the plant will start operations in April 1999.
The project power company is Saba Power Co (Pvt), which is 90 percent owned by Coastal Saba Power, an affiliate of Coastal Power.
Coastal declined to break out its own share of the costs.
Coastal has a 140 megawatt gas-fired power station under construction in Quetta, Pakistan, which wil be completed at the end of this year.

Houston-based Coastal told the Howard Weil energy conference in New Orleans last week that it expected earnings from international power operations to rise to $100 million in 1999 from $40 million in 1996. ((-- David Chance New York Newsroom 212 859 1902))
